findings.summary: reopen_run repeats the alive-then-in-flight refusal sequence that _launcher_refusal already composes at reckon/crew/resumption.py:1398-1405 and that reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1234-1243 composes again, so a change to the refusal order must be made in three places.

The landed evidence table records the scoped measure against the pre-merge head d9efc6416ae3 and never names the delivered head aaf3d86654, whose own-gate 55-passed result exists only in the run manifest, so a plan reader sees evidence for a revision that is not the one delivered.
